title: Zombie apocalypse bridge chase, 7 shots (Seedance 2.5)
prompt_text: Cinematic live-action zombie apocalypse scene, bright sunny daytime, Seoul, South Korea. A broken Han River bridge with a huge collapsed gap, twisted rebar and cracked concrete sticking out. A young Korean schoolgirl (long dark brown hair, wearing a pink Nike dress, white knee socks, sunglasses pushed up on her head) is being chased by a huge horde of zombies across the bridge. Shot 1: Wide shot, the girl leaps mid-air across the collapsed bridge gap over the river, hair flying, zombies at the broken edge behind her. Shot 2: Close-up, she barely grabs the rusty rebar at the edge and hangs over the dark river water, a terrified, desperate face, zombie hand reaching from above. Shot 3: She pulls herself up and sprints down the bridge road, a massive zombie crowd running after her, a white sedan and a green city bus on the road, Seoul apartment skyline in the background. Shot 4: She climbs onto the roof of the green bus while zombies pack the windows and reach out with their arms. Shot 5: Extreme close-up of her shocked, wide-eyed face, wind blowing her hair. Shot 6: She jumps across the tilted bus and wrecked cars at the second broken section, the zombie horde charging behind. Shot 7: Final dramatic leap over the river gap, two men reaching out from the edge, with a black military Black Hawk helicopter hovering at the bridge pier with a rescue rope hanging down. Style: photorealistic, high-octane action, handheld dynamic camera, slow-motion jumps, dramatic wide-angle and low-angle shots, realistic motion blur, sharp detail, cinematic color grading, blockbuster zombie movie look (Train to Busan style), 4K. Negative: cartoon, anime, blurry, distorted faces, extra limbs, text, watermark, low quality. Settings: 16:9, 20 seconds, Seedance 2.5.

title: Baby dragon sneeze medieval fantasy, 6 scenes (Seedance 2.5)
prompt_text: Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic fantasy short film in 16:9 widescreen format, approximately 30 seconds long. Set the scene in a beautiful medieval European village marketplace with traditional stone buildings, wooden houses, colorful flower stalls, warm sunlight, and a magical fantasy atmosphere. Scene 1 (0–4 seconds): The Magical Dragon — Extreme close-up of a cute, adorable baby dragon with pale pink and white scales, tiny horns, delicate facial spikes, and beautiful glowing golden eyes. A colorful butterfly gently lands on the dragon's nose. The dragon looks curious and slightly cross-eyed, watching the butterfly. Scene 2 (4–9 seconds): The Curious Girl — Cut to a beautiful young woman with long dark hair, wearing a simple medieval-style outfit. She stands close to the dragon, looking at it with curiosity and a gentle smile. The dragon's nose begins twitching as it prepares to sneeze. Show an extreme close-up of its large nostrils and funny facial expression. Scene 3 (9–15 seconds): The Unexpected Sneeze — The girl reaches toward the dragon, but suddenly the dragon releases an enormous, powerful sneeze. A magical burst of warm air and glowing particles blasts toward her. Her hair flies wildly backward, her expression changes to complete shock, and her face becomes covered in dark soot and dust. Create a hilarious yet visually spectacular moment with realistic wind physics and detailed facial expressions. Scene 4 (15–21 seconds): The Dragon at the Fountain — Show the adorable pink dragon standing beside an old stone fountain in the medieval marketplace. The dragon looks innocent and slightly embarrassed. The girl stands nearby, completely messy from the sneeze. Villagers in the background react with surprise and amusement. The dragon lowers its head toward the fountain. Scene 5 (21–26 seconds): A Magical Moment — The dragon gently approaches the girl. Show the contrast between its enormous cute face and the girl's surprised expression. The dragon behaves playfully and affectionately, creating a charming fantasy moment. Scene 6 (26–30 seconds): The Sweet Ending — Extreme close-up of the girl's face. She has wet, messy dark hair and a tiny glowing heart-shaped magical mark on her forehead. She looks directly ahead with a surprised but adorable expression. Soft golden sunlight illuminates her face. End with a cinematic close-up and a magical fantasy atmosphere. Visual Style & Quality: Ultra-realistic cinematic fantasy filmmaking; highly detailed dragon skin, scales, eyes, and facial expressions; realistic human facial expressions and natural movements; beautiful medieval European village environment; warm golden-hour lighting; professional cinematic camera angles and smooth transitions; realistic wind, dust, smoke, and magical particle effects; shallow depth of field and professional color grading; consistent character appearance throughout all scenes; high-end CGI blended with photorealistic live-action visuals; 4K ultra-detailed rendering. Important: Maintain perfect character consistency. The pink baby dragon and the young woman must look identical throughout the entire video. Ensure smooth scene transitions, natural physics, expressive reactions, and visually coherent storytelling.
